description: This file defines a TPChart class for rendering network graph visualizations using D3.js, including methods for rendering nodes and links, zooming, dragging, and creating info tips. It references external image assets and D3.js functions.

classes.name: TPChart
classes.description: A class for rendering network topology graphs with nodes and links using D3.js.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders nodes and lines on an SVG element, setting up force layout, zoom, drag, and event handlers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the chart, loading data if necessary, and calls render.
